name: Benchmarks
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - 'main'
  pull_request:
    paths-ignore:
      - 'website/**'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  benchmarks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup env
        uses: the-guild-org/shared-config/setup@v1
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version

      - name: Build Packages
        run: pnpm build

      - name: Setup K6
        run: |
          wget https://github.com/grafana/k6/releases/download/v0.37.0/k6-v0.37.0-linux-amd64.deb
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install ./k6-v0.37.0-linux-amd64.deb

      - name: Start Yoga Server
        working-directory: ./benchmark
        run: |
          pnpm test
        env:
          NODE_NO_WARNINGS: true
          NODE_ENV: production
          GITHUB_PR: ${{ github.event.number }}
          GITHUB_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.BOT_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
  envelop:
    name: envelop benchmarks
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v6

      - name: Setup env
        uses: the-guild-org/shared-config/setup@v1
        with:
          node-version-file: '.node-version'

      - name: Build
        run: pnpm run build

      - name: Setup K6
        run: |
          wget https://github.com/grafana/k6/releases/download/v0.37.0/k6-v0.37.0-linux-amd64.deb
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install ./k6-v0.37.0-linux-amd64.deb

      - name: GraphQL API
        run: |
          pnpm run --filter @envelop/benchmark loadtest:start-server &
          pnpm wait-on tcp:3000

      - name: Run Benchmark
        run:
          k6 -e GITHUB_PR=${{ github.event.number }} -e GITHUB_SHA=${{ github.sha }} -e
          GITHUB_TOKEN=${{secrets.BOT_GITHUB_TOKEN}} -e GRAPHQL_HOSTNAME="[::1]" run
          ./benchmark/envelop/k6.js

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
